purpose: Provide an executable fixture-local committed MassState projection with Closure and rigid-core consumer links and candidate-publication timing.

provenance.notes: This projection-only slice implements identities and domains already fixed by accepted ADR, architecture and executable bundles. Candidate geometry derivation stays outside this model; the accepted constant-geometry scalar-burn choice has the separate REF-YYZ-SCALAR-BURN-MASS-001 identity. Product and Legacy runtime APIs are absent from the executable path.

expected_facts.claim: Independent 80-digit Decimal and C++17 implementations project the exact committed positive mass, body-origin-to-CoM point coordinate and full symmetric-positive-definite inertia about the CoM into one same-boundary MassPropertiesSample.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Model, owner, point, frame, clock, tick, revision, interval and quality identities are exact; finite physical values use the fixture-local absolute-plus-relative formula tolerance.

expected_facts.claim: The projected CoM locates the Closure application vector and the projected mass/full inertia feed the accepted rigid-core specific-force and rotational equations without diagonalization.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Consumer identities are exact; application vectors, wrench intermediates, reciprocal mass, angular momentum and angular acceleration use the fixture-local formula tolerance.

expected_facts.claim: The current committed sample remains visible through its FrozenInterval, the pending scalar mass candidate appears only after the declared commit, and invalid identity/mass/inertia inputs plus early visibility, omitted CoM offset and diagonalized-inertia implementations fail directly.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Visibility, commit tick and rejection identities are exact; tolerance never repairs an invalid state identity, mass or inertia tensor.

acceptance: The bundle records committed projection identity, full inertia, CoM-to-application geometry, direct Closure/rigid-core consumers and candidate publication timing
The Python reference and C++17 probe share no implementation and neither imports product or Legacy code
Mass evolution remains outside this projection-only identity; REF-YYZ-SCALAR-BURN-MASS-001 covers the accepted constant-geometry scalar-burn approximation
